function.name: get_current_weather
function.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA' or 'New York, NY'.

safe_search.description: Enable or disable safe search filtering.
